editorial: Prepare yourself for a cold, clinical dive into the psyche of a professional killer. You will find a refreshing lack of sentimentality here, trading typical action tropes for a gritty, transactional look at the assassin trade. Jessica Chastain carries the entire weight of the film with a performance that is as precise and lethal as the character she portrays. If you crave a lean, mean thriller that prioritizes atmospheric tension over explosive spectacle, this is your play.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of grounded espionage and female-led action thrillers.
